description: Find USGS water monitoring sites by bounding box, state, county, or HUC watershed code, filtered by site type and parameter availability. Returns site numbers, names, coordinates, types, altitude, the UTC time each site last reported (lastObservedAt), and (in expanded mode) drainage area. Call this first — water_get_readings, water_get_series, and water_get_conditions all require a site number. Supply exactly one major filter — bbox, stateCd, countyCd, or huc; siteType, parameterCd, hasDataTypeCd, and observedWithin only narrow within it and cannot stand alone. parameterCd and hasDataTypeCd match sites that have ever reported, discontinued ones included; set observedWithin to keep only sites reporting now. Page through matches with limit/offset (500 per page); truncated=true means matches remain after the returned window and upstreamTotal holds the full count. When the match set exceeds 500 and DataCanvas is enabled, the complete set also stages to a canvas (canvas_id/table_name) — inspect it with water_dataframe_describe, then retrieve it with water_dataframe_query.

bbox.description: Bounding box as "west,south,east,north" in decimal degrees (e.g. "-77.5,38.5,-76.5,39.5" for the DC metro area). One of the four major filters — bbox, stateCd, countyCd, and huc are mutually exclusive with each other, and exactly one must be supplied.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from a prior call to add this match set as a table on an existing canvas rather than creating a new one. Each distinct filter set gets its own table name, so re-running the identical query replaces its own table while a different query adds another alongside it. Applies only when the match set exceeds the inline cap and DataCanvas is enabled. Omit to start a fresh canvas.

countyCd.description: FIPS county code(s) as bare 5-digit numbers — state and county digits concatenated, no separator (e.g. "51013" for Arlington, VA). Comma-separate up to 20 (e.g. "51059,51061"). The 5 digits already encode the state, so the code stands alone. Major filter — supply exactly one of bbox, stateCd, countyCd, huc.

hasDataTypeCd.description: Require sites that have ever reported data of this type: "iv" (instantaneous, continuous record; "uv" and "rt" are aliases), "dv" (daily values), "gw" (groundwater-level field measurements), "pk" (annual peaks). No other code has a source. Comma-separate multiple types. A discontinued site still matches — read lastObservedAt, or set observedWithin to keep only sites reporting now.

huc.description: Hydrologic Unit Code (HUC) scoping results to a watershed: a 2-digit region (e.g. "02" for the Mid-Atlantic) or an 8-digit subbasin (e.g. "02070008" for the Middle Potomac). Matches every site whose HUC starts with it. Major filter — supply exactly one of bbox, stateCd, countyCd, huc.

limit.description: Maximum sites to return inline, 1–500. Default 500 (the inline cap).

observedWithin.description: ISO 8601 duration ending now, the form water_get_readings period takes (e.g. "P7D", "PT6H", "P1Y"). Keeps only sites whose lastObservedAt falls inside it — sites reporting now, not discontinued ones. Counts the series parameterCd and hasDataTypeCd select, or any continuous, daily, or field-measurement series when both are omitted. Daily values and field measurements carry a date only and daily values publish a day or two late, so a window under "P3D" can drop a site that reports daily values only.

offset.description: Number of matching sites to skip before returning results. Page through matches beyond the inline cap by advancing offset by limit. Default 0.

parameterCd.description: 5-digit parameter code each returned site has ever reported (e.g. "00060" for discharge) — a site whose record ended years ago still matches; read lastObservedAt, or set observedWithin to keep only sites reporting now. Matched against the series hasDataTypeCd selects (continuous, daily, and field-measurement series when it is omitted), never discrete water-quality samples, so a site with only lab-analyzed samples for the code does not match. Use water_list_parameters to discover codes. Comma-separate multiple codes with no spaces (e.g. "00060,00065").

siteOutput.description: "basic" returns core identification fields. "expanded" adds drainage area, altitude, contributing area, and other metadata.

siteType.description: Site type filter. Common codes: "ST" (stream), "GW" (groundwater well), "LK" (lake/reservoir), "SP" (spring), "AT" (atmosphere), "OC" (ocean), "ES" (estuary). A major type includes its subtypes ("ST" also matches "ST-CA", "ST-DCH", "ST-TS"); a subtype matches only itself. Comma-separate multiple types (e.g. "ST,GW").

stateCd.description: 2-letter US state or territory postal code, any case (e.g. "VA", "wa", "PR"). Returns all sites in the state for the given filters. Major filter — supply exactly one of bbox, stateCd, countyCd, huc.

name: water_find_sites

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID for the DataCanvas holding the full, uncapped match set. Present only when the match set exceeded the 500-site cap and DataCanvas is enabled. Pass to water_dataframe_describe then water_dataframe_query to retrieve sites beyond the inline cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_sites_found`: No sites match the given geographic and filter criteria. `missing_major_filter`: None of bbox, stateCd, countyCd, or huc was supplied. Every site search is scoped by exactly one of them; siteType, parameterCd, hasDataTypeCd, and observedWithin only narrow within that scope. `conflicting_major_filters`: More than one of bbox, stateCd, countyCd, and huc was supplied. The tool takes exactly one per call. `invalid_request`: A well-formed filter value has no translation — a stateCd that is no US state or territory, a malformed siteType, or a hasDataTypeCd with no source on the USGS Water Data APIs (refused before any request) — or the USGS Water Data API refused the query. `upstream_error`: The USGS Water Data API failed after retries or sent a response this server could not read. `upstream_timeout`: The USGS Water Data requests for this call ran past its 45-second budget. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied canvas_id names a canvas that never existed or has expired. Raised before any USGS request, so no upstream call is spent on it. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: canvas_id was omitted and a fresh canvas was needed to stage the match set, but this tenant already holds the maximum number of active canvases. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

bbox.description: Bounding box filter applied, if any.

countyCd.description: County FIPS filter applied, if any.

hasDataTypeCd.description: Data type filter applied, if any.

huc.description: HUC watershed filter applied, if any.

parameterCd.description: Parameter code filter applied, if any.

siteOutput.description: Site output mode used (basic or expanded).

siteType.description: Site type filter applied, if any.

notice.description: Advisory about the returned window: the staged canvas and how to read it, the filters to narrow by, the window actually returned, the valid offset range when the request landed past the end of the match set, or the fact that a supplied canvas_id went unused because nothing was staged.

sites.description: The requested window of matching USGS monitoring sites — the slice starting at offset, at most limit long (500 max). upstreamTotal holds the full match count; canvas_id/table_name point to the staged full set when it exceeded the cap and DataCanvas is enabled.

items.description: A USGS monitoring site with location, type, and when it last reported.

altitude.description: Altitude of the gage datum in feet above sea level (NAVD 88 or NGVD 29). Present in both basic and expanded modes when USGS records an altitude for the site.

contributingArea.description: Contributing drainage area in square miles (may differ from drainageArea for regulated basins). Populated only when siteOutput="expanded"; absent in basic mode.

countyCd.description: 3-digit FIPS county code within the state (zero-padded, e.g. "013"). Populated only when siteOutput="expanded"; absent in basic mode.

drainageArea.description: Total drainage area in square miles. Populated only when siteOutput="expanded"; absent in basic mode.

hucCd.description: Hydrologic Unit Code of the watershed containing this site; width varies (8-digit HUC8 and 12-digit HUC12, e.g. "020700081005", are both common — do not assume a fixed width), and absent when USGS assigns none. Do not pass it straight back to the huc filter (which takes 2 or 8 digits); HUCs nest, so its first 8 digits are the containing HUC8 that filter accepts.

lastObservedAt.description: UTC time (ISO 8601) of the newest observation among this site’s series that match parameterCd and hasDataTypeCd — any continuous, daily, or field-measurement series when both are omitted. A daily value, field measurement, or peak carries a date only and counts from 00:00 UTC on it. A time years in the past marks a discontinued site. Null when the site has no matching series, or none with a recorded time.

siteName.description: Human-readable USGS site name (e.g. "POTOMAC RIVER AT LITTLE FALLS, MD").

siteNumber.description: USGS site number (8–15 digits). Used by all other water tools.

stateCd.description: 2-digit FIPS state code (e.g. "51" for Virginia). Populated only when siteOutput="expanded"; absent in basic mode.

table_name.description: DuckDB table name in the canvas holding all matching sites. Present when canvas_id is present. Use as the FROM target in water_dataframe_query SQL.

total.description: Number of sites returned inline in this response — at most limit, and 0 when offset is at or past upstreamTotal.

truncated.description: True when matches remain after the returned window (offset + total < upstreamTotal) — false on the last page, and false for a window starting past the end of the match set, where the notice names the valid offset range instead. Advance offset by limit for the next page, narrow filters (add bbox, countyCd, huc, siteType, parameterCd, hasDataTypeCd, or observedWithin), or when canvas_id is present read the staged set with water_dataframe_describe then water_dataframe_query.

upstreamTotal.description: Total number of sites matching the query upstream, before limit/offset windowing. Equals total when the whole match set fits in one window.

title: Water Find Sites
